atlas_legacy_record.note: Values below come from the live legacy atlas page captured on 2026-09-02 and were NOT independently verified in this upgrade pass. They are carried forward for continuity only and must not be cited as evidence.

what_it_is: Airbus Defence and Space is Airbus SE's military and space division, spanning the C295 and A400M airlifters, Eurofighter participation, military communications and Earth-observation satellites such as the Pléiades line. This atlas page covers the space-facing portion of the division relevant to India's satellite and security markets.
india_angle: Airbus DS supplies Indian institutional and commercial space-adjacent demand primarily through satellite imagery, secure communications and the defence ecosystem around the C295/Tata partnership. Its India space engagement is narrower than its defence-aircraft presence and is largely channelled through imagery services and component supply.
intelligence_assessment: Public, verifiable India space-specific activity is limited; the sister dossier on the C295 programme carries the bulk of Airbus's confirmed India footprint. Treat this entity as a watch-list entry for Indian military-satcom and EO procurement cases.

faq.q: Is Airbus Defence and Space active in India's space sector?
faq.a: Its confirmed India footprint is mainly defence-aircraft (C295) related; India space activity is largely imagery services and component supply rather than satellite primes.
